produce_single_action: produce a single power's orders from a Diplomacy game state using ParlAISingleOrderWrapper
produce_joint_action: produce all predicted orders from a single power's perspective using ParlAIAllOrderWrapper
produce_rollout_bilateral: produce a bilateral rollout joint action for two powers using ParlAIPlausiblePseudoOrdersWrapper
score_candidate_actions: score a list of candidate actions with log probabilities using BaseOrderWrapper score_candidate_actions
produce_independent_orders: produce independent orders for each power from a speaker's view using ParlAIAllOrderIndependentWrapper
